lines.en: Mia, look at this report. The conclusion must have been rewritten, because the style is completely different from page ten.
lines.pt: Mia, olhe este relatório. A conclusão deve ter sido reescrita, porque o estilo é completamente diferente da página dez.

lines.en: You may be right. Someone must have edited it last night, since the file was changed at midnight.
lines.pt: Você pode ter razão. Alguém deve ter editado ontem à noite, já que o arquivo foi alterado à meia-noite.

lines.en: It could not have been Dan. He was on a train to Seattle at that time, as far as I know.
lines.pt: Não pode ter sido o Dan. Ele estava num trem para Seattle naquela hora, até onde eu sei.

lines.en: Then it might have been the new intern. She might have wanted to impress the manager before the meeting.
lines.pt: Então pode ter sido a nova estagiária. Ela pode ter querido impressionar a gerente antes da reunião.

lines.en: Possible. But she must have been working very late, because the formatting is perfect now.
lines.pt: Possível. Mas ela deve ter trabalhado até muito tarde, porque a formatação está perfeita agora.

lines.en: True. The old version had so many mistakes that someone must have noticed the problem too.
lines.pt: Verdade. A versão antiga tinha tantos erros que alguém também deve ter notado o problema.

lines.en: Well, the author should have told us, instead of changing everything without any warning.
lines.pt: Bem, a autora deveria ter nos avisado, em vez de mudar tudo sem aviso algum.

lines.en: I agree, although she needn’t have rewritten the whole thing. Two paragraphs were enough, in my opinion.
lines.pt: Concordo, embora ela não precisasse ter reescrito tudo. Dois parágrafos bastavam, na minha opinião.

lines.en: Let’s ask her directly. She may have left a comment somewhere in the document history.
lines.pt: Vamos perguntar a ela diretamente. Ela pode ter deixado um comentário em algum lugar do histórico do documento.

lines.en: Good idea. Oh, here it is: “Rewritten after feedback from the client.” So nobody was hiding anything!
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Ah, aqui está: “Reescrito após o retorno do cliente.” Então ninguém estava escondendo nada!

lines.en: Excellent. We have been worrying for nothing, and we can send the report to the client today.
lines.pt: Excelente. Estávamos nos preocupando à toa e podemos enviar o relatório ao cliente hoje.

facts.label: Deduções no passado
facts.sub: It must have been rewritten. It might have been the intern. It could not have been Dan.

facts.label: must have + particípio
facts.sub: Use must have + particípio quando você tem quase certeza sobre o passado: The conclusion must have been rewritten. Em português: “deve ter sido”. Baseia-se em evidências.

facts.label: might/may/could have
facts.sub: Use might have, may have ou could have + particípio para possibilidades: It might have been the intern. Em português: “pode ter sido”. Menos certeza que must.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Must have been shows strong certainty about the past.
We say “It must have be Dan”.
items.why: We say It must have been Dan.

items.s: Could not have been means it was impossible.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Must have been shows strong certainty about the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “It must have be Dan”. → Falso (We say It must have been Dan.)
Could not have been means it was impossible. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A changed report · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Monday in Portland. Alma arrives early at the office. A report lies open on her desk. Something looks different on page ten. Paulo walks in with a coffee. The meeting is at noon.

“Paulo, look at this report. The conclusion must have been rewritten, because the style is completely different from page ten.” says Alma. “You may be right. Someone must have edited it last night, since the file was changed at midnight.” says Paulo. “It could not have been Dan. He was on a train to Seattle at that time, as far as I know.” says Alma.
